title: Loi n° 2023-041 du 29 août 2023 relative au contenu local dans le secteur minier
citation: Loi n°2023-041 du 29 août 2023, Journal Officiel de la République du Mali n°2023-22 du 1er septembre 2023, from p. 891
evidence: No commencement clause: the last article only orders registration and publication in the Journal Officiel or repeals earlier provisions, so no official page states a first in-force date and in_force is null. Published in JO n°2023-22 du 01 Septembre 2023, opened 2026-11-03 at https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2023/mali-jo-2023-22.pdf (200 application/pdf). Last article (Art. 21): "La présente loi abroge toutes dispositions antérieures contraires."
notes: Duties of mining operators, subcontractors and suppliers: Art. 5 (annual local-content plan, which must contain "g) le rapport détaillant les réalisations de l’entreprise et le descriptif des prévisions" for the last twelve months), Art. 8 (supply plan, semi-annual reports to the Secrétariat Permanent du Contenu Local, annual insurance report), Art. 18 (fines and imprisonment for not sending the supply plan or the execution report on time) and Art. 19. Implemented by ml-decret-2024-0397. The Code minier (Loi n°2023-040 of the same day, Art. 150) refers to this law. The record is dated 2023-09-01, the Journal Officiel date, as the date of the published text; this is not a stated entry into force. French only; no Bambara or other national-language text is served. The Annexe (minimum local-content percentages by service and good, JO pp. 895 to 897, tables) is not in the record text because the tables do not extract to readable text. No government English text found: sgg-mali.ml serves French only, and the Ministry of Mines page (mines.gouv.ml) answered 403 to the cloud address. The register row used an ILO NATLEX copy; its text is not stored.

title: Décret n° 2024-0397/PT-RM du 09 juillet 2024 fixant les conditions et les modalités d’application de la Loi n° 2023-041 du 29 août 2023 relative au contenu local dans le secteur minier
citation: Décret n°2024-0397/PT-RM du 09 juillet 2024, Journal Officiel de la République du Mali n°2024-16 du 19 juillet 2024
evidence: No commencement clause: the last article only orders registration and publication in the Journal Officiel or repeals earlier provisions, so no official page states a first in-force date and in_force is null. Published in JO n°2024-16 du 19 Juillet 2024, opened 2026-11-03 at https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2024/mali-jo-2024-16.pdf (200 application/pdf). Last article (Art. 69) orders its execution and says the décret "sera enregistré et publié au Journal officiel".
notes: Implements ml-loi-2023-041: Title III sets the operator's duties, among them the local-content plan and its yearly revision (Art. 31 to 36), semi-annual reports on the plan to the Secrétariat permanent (Art. 38), the insurance report due by 30 April each year (Art. 52), then control, sanctions and appeals. The record is dated 2024-07-19, the Journal Officiel date, as the date of the published text; this is not a stated entry into force. French only. No government English text found on sgg-mali.ml.

title: Loi n° 2021-032 du 24 mai 2021 relative aux pollutions et aux nuisances
citation: Loi n°2021-032 du 24 mai 2021, Journal Officiel de la République du Mali n°2021-16 du 28 mai 2021
evidence: No commencement clause: the last article only orders registration and publication in the Journal Officiel or repeals earlier provisions, so no official page states a first in-force date and in_force is null. Published in JO n°2021-16 du 28 Mai 2021, opened 2026-11-03 at https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2021/mali-jo-2021-16.pdf (200 application/pdf). Art. 71: "La présente loi abroge la Loi n° 01-020 du 30 mai 2001 relative aux pollutions et aux nuisances."
notes: Environmental framework act. Art. 4 subjects activities likely to harm the environment to an environmental and social impact study or notice (list and procedure by décret, Art. 5: ml-decret-2018-0991); Art. 6 makes an environmental audit compulsory for industrial, agricultural, mining, artisanal, commercial and transport activities that may pollute; the definition of audit (Art. 1) names compliance with environmental rules "y compris les changements climatiques". Repeals Loi n° 01-020 du 30 mai 2001 (notes only; not in scope). Amended by Ordonnance n°2025-018/PT-RM (ml-ordonnance-2025-018), ratified by Loi n°2025-028 du 3 juillet 2025 (JO n°2025-20 du 04/07/2025, https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2025/mali-jo-2025-20.pdf, not stored as its own record). The Journal Officiel serves no consolidated text, so the record is the adopted text of 2021-05-28 (the Journal Officiel date; not a stated entry into force); the amendments are in the separate ordonnance record. French only. No government English text found on sgg-mali.ml. The environment ministry site (www.environnement.gouv.ml) could not be opened from the cloud address: its TLS certificate has expired.

title: Ordonnance n° 2025-018/PT-RM du 01 avril 2025 portant modification de la Loi n° 2021-032 du 24 mai 2021 relative aux pollutions et aux nuisances
citation: Ordonnance n°2025-018/PT-RM du 01 avril 2025, Journal Officiel de la République du Mali n°2025-11 du 04 avril 2025 (supplément); ratified by Loi n°2025-028 du 3 juillet 2025
evidence: No commencement clause: the last article only orders registration and publication in the Journal Officiel or repeals earlier provisions, so no official page states a first in-force date and in_force is null. Published in JO n°2025-11 du 04 Avril 2025 (supplément, fichier mali-jo-2025-11-2.pdf), opened 2026-11-03 at https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2025/mali-jo-2025-11-2.pdf (200 application/pdf). Art. 2: "La présente ordonnance sera enregistrée et publiée au Journal officiel."
notes: Replaces Art. 48 to 57 (enforcement officers, seizure) and Art. 59, 62 and 68 of Loi n°2021-032. Art. 62 (nouveau) fines 5 000 000 francs anyone who carries out a project likely to harm the environment without an approved environmental and social impact study, and the administration stops the works. Ratified by Loi n°2025-028 du 3 juillet 2025 (JO n°2025-20 du 04/07/2025, https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2025/mali-jo-2025-20.pdf, Article unique); that law is not stored as its own record. The record is dated 2025-04-04, the Journal Officiel date, as the date of the published text; this is not a stated entry into force. French only. No government English text found on sgg-mali.ml.

title: Décret n° 2018-0991/P-RM du 31 décembre 2018 relatif à l’étude et à la notice d’impacts environnemental et social
citation: Décret n°2018-0991/P-RM du 31 décembre 2018, Journal Officiel de la République du Mali n°2018-51 du 28 décembre 2018
evidence: No commencement clause: the last article only orders registration and publication in the Journal Officiel or repeals earlier provisions, so no official page states a first in-force date and in_force is null. Published in JO n°2018-51 du 28 Décembre 2018, opened 2026-11-03 at https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2018/mali-jo-2018-51.pdf (200 application/pdf). Art. 43: "Le présent décret abroge toutes dispositions antérieures contraires, notamment le Décret n°08-346/P-RM du 26 juin 2008, modifié, relatif à l’Etude d’Impact environnemental et social."
notes: Implements Art. 4 and 5 of ml-loi-2021-032 (the décret cites the repealed Loi n°01-020 in its visas; the 2021 law carries the same impact-study duty). Sorts projects into categories A, B and C (list in the Annexe, which is in the record text) and sets the study and notice procedure, the reports, monitoring (Chapter V) and sanctions (Chapter VI). Repeals Décret n°08-346/P-RM du 26 juin 2008 (notes only). Date oddity: the décret is dated 31 décembre 2018 but the issue that prints it (JO n°2018-51) carries the date 28 Décembre 2018, earlier than the signature, so that date cannot be the publication date. The record is dated 2018-12-31, the date of the décret, as the date of the text; this is not a stated entry into force. French only. No government English text found on sgg-mali.ml.

title: Loi n° 2015-036 du 16 juillet 2015 relative à la protection du consommateur
citation: Loi n°2015-036 du 16 juillet 2015 portant protection du consommateur, Journal Officiel de la République du Mali n°2015-35 du 7 août 2015
evidence: No commencement clause: the last article only orders registration and publication in the Journal Officiel or repeals earlier provisions, so no official page states a first in-force date and in_force is null. Published in JO n°2015-35 du 7 août 2015, opened 2026-11-03 at https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2015/mali-jo-2015-35.pdf (200 application/pdf). Art. 73: "La présente loi portant protection du consommateur abroge toutes les dispositions antérieures contraires."
notes: Umbrella for environmental claims; the law does not mention them. Art. 3 defines "publicité mensongère" (advertising with false or misleading allegations, indications or presentations) and Art. 20 makes the person guilty of it liable to the penalties in force. Art. 46 requires every good and service, locally produced or imported, to comply with environmental norms (a product-conformity rule, not a claims rule). Implemented by Décret n°2016-0482/P-RM du 7 juillet 2016 (JO n°2016-30, https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2016/mali-jo-2016-30.pdf), not in scope. The record is dated 2015-08-07, the Journal Officiel date, as the date of the published text; this is not a stated entry into force. French only. No government English text found on sgg-mali.ml.
